body.title: Closing: k1-k5, crosswalk, deferred amendments and the live hand check
body.summary: Score the Epic constraints k1-k5 against the finished change in the BUILD summary; carry the c-id crosswalk (c11 and c12 to read:store-retry-surface, c13 and c3 to read:worker-and-outbox); list the deferred HLD additions for the Epic-end batch (sc1 retryNow, sc4 retry-now action, sc5 outbox-retry-now completion, and S003's markNotDeliveredIfHead, presenceOf, holderGone and the same-windowKey takeOver rule). Run the live hand check with a real provider failure: a passing provider failure before acting waits, shows its countdown and runs again; retry-now runs it at once; a failure after an edit stays failed; check the classifier against the logged texts. If no real failure can be produced, record the check as not run with the reason, and record a fault-injection run (a fake CLI that prints an overload result) as evidence of the wiring, clearly labelled as such.
acceptanceChecks: the BUILD summary scores k1-k5 and lists the deferred HLD additions and the crosswalk
the classifier's patterns are compared with the failure texts the logs captured, and any miss is recorded
the hand check is recorded as a reported live test with its evidence, or recorded as not run with the reason and the fault-injection evidence labelled as such

tests.name: hand check with a real provider failure: a passing provider error before acting waits, shows its countdown and runs again; retry-now runs it at once; a failure after an edit stays failed
